book_meta.work: Le Tour du monde en quatre-vingts jours
book_meta.author: Jules Verne

sentences.en: They ran to the elephant.
Passepartout carrying Aouda, the guide ahead.
And behind them, the priests understood.
And shouted, and ran after them, and fired.
But the elephant was faster.
And entered the forest, and the noise faded.

sentences.ar: والسير فرانسيس مسك إيد باسبارتو، وقال: يا شجاع!
sentences.en: And Sir Francis gripped Passepartout's hand, and said: brave man!
And Passepartout laughed, and said: I was an acrobat.
And Fogg said: well done.
One word.

sentences.ar: بس باسبارتو حس إنها أكبر من ألف.
sentences.en: But Passepartout felt it was worth a thousand.
And Aouda slept in the basket, her face pale.
And the elephant walked, and the sun rose.
They reached the railway station in the afternoon.
And the train to Calcutta waiting.
Fogg paid the guide his wage.
And said: and the elephant is yours.
The guide could not believe it.
An elephant worth two thousand pounds.

sentences.ar: وباسبارتو باس الفيل على خرطومه، وودعه.
sentences.en: And Passepartout kissed the elephant on its trunk, and bade it farewell.
And on the train, Aouda woke.
And looked around, and did not understand.
And Sir Francis told her.
Everything.
And she looked at Fogg, and at Passepartout.
And could not speak.
And then said: thank you.
In perfect English.

sentences.ar: وفوغ قال: ما في داعي يا سيدتي.
sentences.en: And Fogg said: no need, madam.
I had the time.
